checks.name: Standalone and joint outputs keep exact recovered Float32 words with distinct eyes
checks.actual2TTargetsScope: Source-reviewed runtime asserts distinct field objects/targets/textures and holds both until readback; saved output words independently confirm correct eye results. This audit cannot inspect already disposed native handles.

checks.name: Raw evidence and production sources stay immutable; timings are separate task observations
checks.timingInterpretation: Mirror/light/joint are different sequential cold/warm instrumented workloads, not A/B arms. Do not sum them or infer causal speedup, complete frame rate or full-scene cost.

limits: Full saved valid rows and exactly eight saved partials per selected kernel; not all partial-texture cells or allocated output suffix readback.

Summary last-bit comparisons allow only bounded binary64 decimal/evaluator drift; raw numerical gates unchanged. Unique nearestFloat32 recovery is explicit and is not a signed-zero text transport guarantee.
State and target lifecycle statements bind saved actual receipts plus reviewed immutable runtime source; no new live native inspection.
Fixed numerical jobs only; no production cap promotion, live preparedView integration, evolving-frame/FPS/visual/HDR approval.
